beats.headline: A name on a ring
beats.text: Frank hands Carl a ring and does not make sense while he does it. The item's full title: Enchanted Night Wyrm's Ring of Divine Suffering. For the discerning crawler killer, and its wielder can grow exponentially in strength, especially on the deeper floors. Whose name is on it, the item does not say. That is the whole of the file for now: a name in the possessive, on a ring meant for killing crawlers.

beats.headline: A demigod with a cult
beats.text: Carl touches the spiderweb on his elbow: the Night Wyrm's Nasty Little Web of Suffering, access to the Guild of Suffering. Mordecai frowns. It is a cult, he says, not a real guild and not a real church. They have outreach centres. They worship a demigod, the Night Wyrm, who is not a regular member of the pantheon; similar to Samantha. There is a memorial crystal involved, whose purpose has never been established, and all of it ties back to that ring.

beats.headline: My little darling
beats.text: Katia's Lock Box of the Night Wyrm needs one last seal: a job from the Guild of Suffering, whose entrance hides in the Penis Parade. She has one. Carl reads it off a slip of dried skin, in a hissing voice like a naga's: the Night Wyrm has a task for you, my little darling. The family with many eyes sacrifices the weak to support the many. We wish to remove the competition. Kill Astrid, assistant manager of the Desperado Club. Speak the details aloud and the contract is void.

beats.headline: A voice in a dark room
beats.text: Crawler Carl's report to Katia: a dark room and a naga-like voice. He never saw the speaker. Asked whether he wanted a job for the family, Carl said no. Asked whether he meant to kill Katia for the prize, no. Asked for a map of the club's secret passages, the voice said it had one, and spiders swarmed up Carl's arm and filled his map: tunnels, a hidden potion market, drug dens. The achievement at the door called him just some demigod trying to scrabble his way to the top.

beats.headline: Astrid names her husband
beats.text: According to the Night Wyrm, Astrid always uses the secret stairwell onto the middle floor. She flies past it to the regular stairs. Minutes on, cornered in a kitchen with a demon loose in her club, Astrid tells Carl: if you see my husband, tell him I did it to keep them safe. Him and my children. My husband is named Hamed, but he is known as the Night Wyrm. Don't tell him I told you his real name. His lair is on the top floor. The man who hired her killers.

beats.headline: She who brings the body
beats.text: Job update, in the hissing voice: the mark is dead, my little sweets. Excellent work. We are stronger because you have fulfilled your duty. Bring her filthy body to the guild. Remember, she who brings the body is she who gets paid. Crawler Carl, reeling, asks himself who these children of hers are. The body is in Katia's inventory.

beats.headline: What the family is
beats.text: Damascus Steel, on the floor of the Penis Parade: Astrid and the Night Wyrm are his parents, and Anaconda's. We were promised freedom, he says. He wanted to make sure she was dead. They are still married, she had so much, and he gets it all when they get out. Then both sons walk back into the cubicles, toward his lair. Crawler Carl's theory, offered to Katia afterwards: a family stuck in the dungeon a very long time, not generated NPCs but indentured, the father playing the Night Wyrm, and the motive money.

beats.headline: New management at the club
beats.text: Clarabelle, alive, at her post: crawlers are banned by order of the new management. He wants his first days to go smoothly. He is very particular and very serious about security, and has a whole slew of bodyguards, not exactly NPCs and not exactly former crawlers. His name is Hamed. Crawler Carl keeps his face still. The real name of the Night Wyrm, the head of the Guild of Suffering, husband to the late Astrid. His sons are supposedly still in the club, hunting him.

beats.headline: An audience granted
beats.text: Splash Zone, in chat, while Crawler Carl is busy separating a goat from a unicorn: he has asked for an audience with Hamed, the new leader guy, to see whether he can help find Splash Zone's wife. The guards said Hamed would see him. So he, Gluteus and Doctor Bones are going to talk to him. He is sending Bucket Boy over to Carl in the meantime.

beats.headline: Gone off the floor
beats.text: Warning: as this mercenary is no longer on this floor, they are unable to be contacted. Splash Zone. Gluteus. Doctor Bones. Same warning for each, and the daily fee still charged. Bucket Boy, the one they sent away, says they were going to see the new boss guy, Hamed, Anaconda and Damascus Steel's dad. Crawler Carl has no idea what that family is doing, and no time to find out. The notices do not say anyone is dead.

beats.headline: The guards fear him
beats.text: At the club door a troll guard named Klonder objects to letting a party of crawlers through. Hamed, he says, is going to kill them for it. A cretin from the house band, a door guard for a very long time, points out that tenth-floor crawlers kill you if you try to stop them, and Klonder bows them in. Inside, Crawler Carl lays out the problem. Hamed set him up to murder his own wife. His sons went hunting him and seemed to change their minds and join his cause. Now the other dancers have done the same. Carl does not trust him. He trusts them.

beats.headline: A despot, per the AI
beats.text: The AI's arbitrary list of the Big Six groups trying to take over or escape its dungeon. Under the NPCs, several offshoot groups, including "that Hamed despot and his ill-advised attempt at creating a dungeon revolution for the early indentured." Separately, and with a hint: Mitch, the croupier at the wheel and the strongest shadow mimic in the room, is still a baby at level 120, and was sent up by a redacted party to wreck Hamed's plans.
